subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
lesson: Unit 3: Renewable Energy – Reading and Understanding
outcomes: Identify the purpose and style of an email.
Find facts about renewable energy in an infographic and texts.

tf.s: 'Dear Mr Brown' is a formal greeting.
tf.why: Yes, 'Dear' plus a title and surname is formal.

tf.s: An email that starts with 'Hi' and ends with 'Take care' is formal.
tf.why: 'Hi' and 'Take care' are friendly, informal words.

tf.s: 'Kind regards' is a closing for a formal email.
tf.why: Correct, it is a polite way to end a formal email.

tf.s: An infographic shows information with pictures and short text.
tf.why: Right, it is a visual way to share facts.

tf.s: A hydroelectric dam uses the sun to generate electricity.

tf.why: Well done, two words together make one noun.

tf.s: Wind farms contain turbines that generate electricity.
tf.why: Yes, many turbines together make a wind farm.

tf.s: 'I am writing to request some information.' shows the purpose is an invitation.
tf.why: The word 'request' tells us the purpose is asking for information.

tf.s: The capacity of a power project is often measured in megawatts.
tf.why: Correct, megawatts show how much power it can produce.

tf.s: Geothermal power uses the wind to make steam.
tf.why: Geothermal power uses natural heat and steam in the ground.

boxes.why: Formal emails use 'Dear' with a title.

boxes.q: Which word is a compound noun?

boxes.why: Wind farms are full of turbines.

boxes.q: An email that invites someone has the purpose of…

o: a visual with pictures and short text

hunt.q: Power from heat in the ground

mcq.q: What are the main parts of an email?
mcq.why: Every email needs a greeting and a closing around the message.

mcq.q: What does a solar power plant do?
o: It stores water behind a wall.
It uses steam from volcanoes only.
mcq.why: Solar plants turn sunlight into electricity.

mcq.q: Which of these is formal language?
o: I am writing to request some information.
mcq.why: Formal emails use full, polite sentences.

o: two words that make one noun
a word that describes a verb

mcq.q: An email ends with 'Take care, see you soon!'. What style is it?
mcq.why: These friendly words show an informal style.

mcq.q: Complete the fact: ______ energy comes from sources that do not run out.
mcq.why: Renewable sources like the sun keep going.

mcq.q: You want to find the capacity of a wind farm in the text. What should you look for?
mcq.why: Capacity is given as a number of megawatts.

mcq.q: Why are infographics useful for sharing facts?
o: They present information visually and briefly.
mcq.why: Pictures and short text make facts easy to see.

mcq.q: Why does an email need a clear purpose?
o: So the reader understands what is needed and replies quickly.
So we do not need a greeting.
mcq.why: A clear purpose helps the reader act.

mcq.q: 'Hydropower' is made of 'hydro' + 'power'. What does it tell you?
o: It is power from the sun.
It is power from the wind.
mcq.why: 'Hydro' means water, so hydropower uses water.
